description: This Java source file defines the ConnectivityInternalErrorException class, a custom unchecked exception used within the connectivity service of the Eclipse Ditto project. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ConnectivityException, providing constructors, static factory methods, and a builder to create instances with specific headers, messages, descriptions, causes, and hrefs.

classes.description: An exception indicating an internal error in the connectivity service, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing ConnectivityException. It includes static factory methods and a builder for flexible construction.
